Some info on the game based on the links in the source:

Early build of never finished game for Famicom. This is Namco version which has nothing to do with the final Famicom version from Atari.

This project was by Atari for Namcot in Japan for the Famicom specifically, this was never a planned U.S. title, it's an unreleased Famicom game. Documentation in the repo shows that they halted development when they realized they didn't actually have the full rights to the game. There was some discussion about re-theming the game to a space themed Millipede clone, but that probably never went anywhere.
The Japanese release for this game has different puzzles than all the western releases for this series. It isn't a clone of other regions' games.
The dump is correct, but the ROM itself is bad (invalid opcode)
The game doesn’t have a CPU player, so you’ll need two controllers connected to play.
The game is in english, except the lyrics in the hidden "Theme song" menu, unlockable after game completion.

This Fantasy Zone is not the same game as the USA unlicensed release. This one should not be P/C connected with those.

This game is a unique port of the arcade game Rainbow Islands for the European market. It is not the same port as the other Rainbow Islands releases. Hence, it is NOT a clone of the other games.
This game is a unique port of the arcade game Rampart for the Japanese market. It is not the same port as the other Rampart releases. Hence, it is NOT a clone of the other games.
This game is a unique port of the computer game Maniac Mansion for the Japanese market. It is not the same port as the other Maniac Mansion releases. Hence, it is NOT a clone of the other games.
